request: Fix Honey Telegram wallet prerequisite so connected wallets can be selected and signature-verified in context

entries.note: Reused the existing Honey proof boundary and canonical EVM validation to expose only locally signable wallet choices.
Reused the encrypted local vault metadata listing so the Honey status route returns existing wallets without exposing private key material.
Wired the existing nonce-sign-link contract into the Honey prerequisite UI instead of inventing another linking flow.
Reused the established Wallets controls and action-prop pattern for the wallet picker and signature action.
Extended the focused Honey contract with wallet normalization, proof wiring, explicit-choice, and Telegram-gating assertions.
